scenes.text: If your phone is the last thing you see at night, try this for 7 days.

scenes.title: Charge it outside the bedroom.
scenes.body: Pick one spot — kitchen counter, hallway. **Not the nightstand.**

scenes.title: Set a hard cutoff.
scenes.body: Same time every night (e.g. 10:30). Use your phone's built-in **Bedtime / Downtime** mode.

scenes.title: Grayscale after cutoff.
scenes.body: Colour is part of the pull. **Grey makes feeds boring.**

scenes.title: Make it physical.
scenes.body: If willpower fails, a **timed lock box** means you can't "just check one thing".

caption:
